local-browser-smoke.instructions: Use only synthetic local fixtures: node scripts/r11b-browser-fixture.mjs or node scripts/release-1-checkout-browser-fixture.mjs. Inspect affected routes and stop owned loopback fixtures afterward. No real provider/customer data or installed acceptance follows.

workos-auth-staging.instructions: BLOCKED until an exact separately authorized protected staging target, reader and effect budget exist. Verify current shared contracts first; no real mail, social login or credentials from routine local work.

website-api-account-session-staging.instructions: With separate explicit staging authority, verify authenticated linked/unlinked/unavailable session and cross-customer denial through server-side API consumers. No browser-selected identity or retained customer data.

api-owned-commerce-email-staging.instructions: API-owned WorkOS/Lemon effects, checkout/webhooks/reconciliation and any mail require separate exact staging authorization. A browser redirect, local fixture or preflight is not commerce or delivery acceptance.

production-release-validation.instructions: UNRUN. Production hosting, purchases, email, migrations, provider configuration and release enablement require separate explicit authority and accepted shared gates. Do not operate production during local validation.

cloudflare-local-qualification.instructions: Local synthetic application checks only: node scripts/cloudflare/prepare-build.mjs; use its exact output directory with node scripts/cloudflare/runtime-check.mjs <directory>. No provider credentials, actual capacity claims, runtime replacement or deployment. Resource-specific private operator tooling is retained separately and is not part of this public source snapshot.
